description: Validate an existing ZUGFeRD/Factur-X/E-Rechnung invoice. Accepts a base64-encoded PDF or raw CII XML. Runs the full three-validator check: PDF/A conformance, EN 16931 Schematron, and the official German KoSIT acceptance gate. No authentication required. Keywords: E-Rechnung prüfen, ZUGFeRD validieren, Factur-X check, Rechnung compliance.
name: validate_einvoice
